title: Renting a Car for the Weekend
context: A customer visits a car hire branch to arrange a short weekend rental.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Good afternoon, welcome to Roadway Car Hire. How can I help you today?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Hi there. I'd like to hire a car for the weekend, please.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: No problem at all. Can I take your name first?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Yes, it's Tom Whitlock.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Could you spell your surname for me?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Sure, it's W-H-I-T-L-O-C-K. Whitlock.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: W-H-I-T-L-O-C-K. Thank you. Could I also get a contact number, in case we need to reach you?

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Let me read that back to you. 07892 445561.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: That's correct.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Great. Now, what sort of car were you looking for?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: I was going to ask for an economy car, but actually there'll be four of us with luggage, so maybe a compact would be better.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: A compact car then, good choice, there's more boot space than the economy model.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Yes, that's what I thought.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: And when would you like to pick it up?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: I was planning to collect it on Friday afternoon, but my train's been delayed, so let's make that Saturday morning instead.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Saturday morning, no trouble at all. And how many days will you need it for?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Three days, so I'll bring it back on Monday.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Right, three days. Our daily rate for a compact is 35 pounds a day, so that works out at 105 pounds in total.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: 105 pounds, okay, that's fine.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: There's also a refundable deposit, which covers the insurance excess. That's 150 pounds, taken from your card when you collect the car, and returned once it's brought back undamaged.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: 150 pounds deposit, got it.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Now, will you be the only driver, or would you like to add someone else?

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: My wife might drive as well, actually, so let's add her.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: That's fine. An extra driver is 8 pounds per day.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Okay, that's worth it for the flexibility.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Which branch would you like to collect the car from? We have one at the airport and one in the town centre.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: The airport one's out of my way. I'll come to the town centre branch.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Good, that's on Church Street. When you arrive, please bring your driving licence and the credit card you booked with.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Driving licence and the card, understood.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: Just to mention the fuel policy as well — the car is given to you with a full tank, and we ask you to return it full too, rather than paying our refuelling charge.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Full to full, no problem, I'll fill it up on the way back.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: There's also a mileage limit of 100 miles a day included in the price. Anything over that is charged at 20 pence a mile.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: That should be plenty for what we're doing.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: One more thing — please have the car back by six in the evening on the day you return it, or a late fee applies.

script.speaker: Customer
script.text: Six pm on Monday, noted. Thanks very much for your help.

script.speaker: Agent
script.text: You're welcome. See you Saturday morning, Tom.

questions.instruction: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

sections.heading: The booking
bullets: Day the car will be collected: {{q4}}

questions.explanation: The customer spells the name aloud: W-H-I-T-L-O-C-K. Spelling out loud in IELTS listening is almost always the cue that this is an answer worth writing down exactly.
The number is given once and then read back by the agent for confirmation. Use the read-back to check your digits rather than trusting only the first time you hear them.

questions.sentence: Type of car booked: a ___ car
questions.explanation: He first says economy, then corrects himself with "actually ... maybe a compact would be better." The word before the correction is a distractor, not the answer.

questions.sentence: Day the car will be collected: ___
questions.explanation: Friday is mentioned first as the original plan, but the delayed train means he changes it: "let's make that Saturday morning instead." Take the corrected version.

questions.instruction: Complete the table below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explanation: 35 pounds a day is the daily rate, but the question asks for the total, which the agent states directly as "105 pounds in total."
The deposit covering the insurance excess is stated as "150 pounds", separate from the 105-pound rental cost mentioned just before it.
Once the customer agrees to add his wife as a second driver, the agent states the charge: "an extra driver is 8 pounds per day."

questions.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.question: Which branch will the customer collect the car from?
questions.explanation: He says the airport branch is "out of my way" and chooses the town centre branch instead, which the agent confirms is on Church Street.

questions.question: How must the customer return the car's fuel tank?
questions.explanation: The agent explains the policy is "full to full": the car is given full and must be returned full to avoid the refuelling charge.

questions.question: What happens if the customer drives more than 100 miles in a day?
options: an extra charge per mile applies
questions.explanation: The agent states that mileage over the 100-mile daily limit "is charged at 20 pence a mile", ruling out both other options.
